{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Verify premises
assert 'customer_age' in df.columns, "Data does not contain customer_age column"
assert df['customer_age'].dtype == 'int64', "customer_age is not numeric"
assert (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum() == 108, "Expected 108 missing age values (marked as -1)"

# Filter out missing age values
valid_age_df = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Compute mean age
mean_age = valid_age_df['customer_age'].mean()

# Compute and print the number of valid age entries
n_valid_age = len(valid_age_df)

# Print required values
print(f"mean_age: {mean_age}")
print(f"n_valid_age: {n_valid_age}")
print(f"n_missing_age: {len(df) - n_valid_age}")"}
